data.name: 铁血霸业传奇
data.detailed_description:
【Game Overview】

鐵血霸業傳奇 is a Three Kingdoms-themed legendary role-playing game. You begin as an unknown warrior and explore war-torn lands, challenge monsters and bosses, collect equipment and materials, and grow stronger through character progression, equipment upgrades, and warrior development.

【World Background】

In the final years of the Eastern Han dynasty, the empire falls into chaos as warlords rise across the land. As battles spread through the realm, you will rise from an ordinary fighter into a powerful leader, fighting through different battlefields and factions to build your own empire.

【Core Gameplay】

Explore maps inspired by the Three Kingdoms era and challenge monsters, bosses, and higher-level battle areas.

Gain equipment, materials, and progression resources through combat, exploration, and boss challenges.

Upgrade equipment, forge powerful weapons, and steadily improve your combat strength.

Recruit and develop warriors, build different progression paths, and prepare for harder challenges.

Take part in faction, siege, and guild-related content as you pursue long-term growth and greater goals.

【Equipment and Progression】

Equipment is a key part of character growth. Players can obtain gear through combat and exploration, then improve it through enhancement, upgrading, and forging. As your strength increases, you will unlock more challenging maps, bosses, and gameplay content.

【Long-Term Content】

The game will continue to expand around dungeon challenges, boss battles, equipment progression, warrior development, faction gameplay, and siege content. We will continue improving combat, progression, and long-term goals based on version updates and player feedback.
